'''Giradda''' was a powerful and famous [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] boss on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] that sponsored the cruel sport [[Huttball/Legends|Huttball]]. Sometime during the [[Galactic War]], he opened a huttball arena on [[Quesh]] called the [[Arena of Death]].<ref name="Web">{{TORweb|url=info/media/trailers/huttball|text=Trailer - Huttball}}</ref>
